# Issue 1: Scaffold Python backend for expense categorization MVP

## Title
Set up FastAPI backend skeleton for expense categorization app

## Description
Create the initial Python project structure for the MVP backend, including:
- FastAPI app entrypoint
- basic project folders
- environment configuration support
- a simple health endpoint to verify startup

## Acceptance Criteria
- A runnable FastAPI app starts locally
- Environment variables are supported
- A basic `/health` or equivalent endpoint returns success
